fix: the armies at once broke camp and withdrew
reason: ἐξ αὐτῆς is the idiom 'immediately'; ἀνέζευξαν means broke camp. 'From the place' misreads it.

fix: each of the sailors of the undecked ships
reason: ἀφρακτῖται are men serving in undecked (aphract) ships, not upper-deck rowers. The gift went to each man, so 'sailors' rather than 'crews'.

fix: when the Lycians seemed on the point of rising again
reason: ὅσον οὔπω means 'all but, on the point of'. The current English reverses the sense.
